race.comment: BECAUSEYOU'RE MINE (5) crossed from a wide gate to open up a big lead last start over 1200m at Hamilton but the effort told and he found a couple better late in the piece. Easy winner at this level the run prior. Will give them something to catch. ABBY'S CROSSWORD (7) started at $1.75 and gave punters little cause for concern in a similar race to this at Dunkeld last weekend. Has taken a long while to hit her straps but the form either side of a spell has been impressive. Great chance to go back-to-back. Lightly raced filly FOX PHIRE (10) opened this prep with a soft maiden in at St Arnaud. Draws a nice gate and has the ability to go to this next level. ICY POLE (3) hasn't fired in two runs this prep but drops in grade - worth another chance.
